parameters.query:
select n.id as notification_id, n.will_id, n.lead_id, n.trigger_state, n.sequence_step, n.template_key, n.portal_link, n.blocking_reason_snapshot, l.full_name, l.email, w.status as will_status
from notifications n
join wills w on w.id = n.will_id
join leads l on l.id = n.lead_id
where n.sent_at is null and n.cancelled_at is null and n.scheduled_for <= now() and n.source = 'system'
  and w.active_notification_state = n.trigger_state
order by n.scheduled_for
limit 50;
update notifications set sent_at = now() where id = '{{ $json.notification_id }}' and sent_at is null and cancelled_at is null returning id;

nodes.name: Claim (no double-send)
nodes.notes: Runs once per due row. If it returns 0 rows, another run already sent/cancelled it — the IF below skips the email.
